name: vibesdk-apps-api-lambda
description: API Gateway HTTP API (v2) Lambda handler for the app listing/detail/favorite/star/visibility/delete routes (worker/api/routes/appRoutes.ts), wired to vibesdk-db-apps and vibesdk-auth-orchestration (for token validation). Not part of the main vibesdk build.

scripts.package: npm run build && echo '{"type":"module"}' > dist/package.json && cd dist && zip -r ../apps-api-lambda.zip handler.js package.json
